description: This file is a CMake module script that defines a function 'compile_aidl' used to generate source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes documentation and code for invoking the AIDL compiler with appropriate options, handling paths and parameters, and integrating with the build system.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: A CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code, supporting parameters for specifying the AIDL compiler path, language, include directories, flags, and target output directory, with internal logic to execute the compilation process.
